text: Loop hook: commit graph and code together; park human questions as unclear
description: From MCP-agent feedback (2026-10-16): graph updates landed in separate 'Aimparency graph updates' commits, and agents did not know how to park a blocking design question. The Stop hook message and install protocol now say: commit the code with the .bowman idea files it changed in one commit (git then links idea↔code, so no commit-SHA field is needed), leave others' changes unstaged; an idea needing a human decision goes to unclear (human-dependent for a human action) with the question in the status comment and leaves the priority list.

status.comment: scripts/hooks/codex-continue-on-stop.sh + packages/mcp/src/tools/hooks.ts; hook contract test PASS, mcp 47/47. Felix to confirm the wording.
